description: The retirement candidate's kernels (vLLM wo-retire 2b0f96b27): the WO and block-32 tests, then the WO and the DSpark context-KV projection against B12X at every size, warm and cold.
argv: import subprocess, sys; codes = [subprocess.call([sys.executable, '-m', 'pytest', '-q', '--noconftest', '-p', 'no:cacheprovider', '-rfE', 'tests/kernels/quantization/test_deepseek_v41_tilelang_wo.py']), subprocess.call([sys.executable, '-m', 'pytest', '-q', '--noconftest', '-p', 'no:cacheprovider', '-rfE', '-k', 'block32_rows or mxfp8', 'tests/kernels/quantization/test_deepseek_v41_tilelang_linear.py']), subprocess.call([sys.executable, '/b/bench_wo.py']), subprocess.call([sys.executable, '/b/bench_context_kv.py'])]; print('exit codes', codes); sys.exit(max(codes))
